title: Russia and Ukraine accuse each other of failing to pause strikes
description: The comments came after US Middle East envoy Steve Witkoff left Moscow.

title: She Worked in a Harvard Lab to Reverse Aging, Until ICE Jailed Her
description: President Trump’s immigration crackdown ensnared Kseniia Petrova, a scientist who fled Russia after protesting its invasion of Ukraine. She fears arrest if she is deported there.

title: Poland's divisions on display as presidential candidates bicker in a live TV debate
description: Bickering and chaos were on display in a presidential debate in Poland as eight candidates met to discuss existential matters for this country on NATO’s eastern flank — including fears of Russia over its war in Ukraine and concerns about President Donald Trump’s commitment to Europe’s security.

title: 'Explosive' Murder Mystery At Heart Of Wayne Author's Debut Novel
description: 'Explosive' Murder Mystery At Heart Of Wayne Author's Debut Novel - Wayne, NJ - "Nina's Friends" is described as an international suspense thriller, set during the early months of Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

title: Trump envoy Steve Witkoff meets with Putin in Russia
description: The meeting between Russian President Vladimir Putin and Steve Witkoff is part of negotiations for a Ukraine war ceasefire, the White House said.

title: Putin meets US envoy for talks - as Trump calls for Russia to 'get moving' to end war in Ukraine
description: Despite Russia playing down expectations of a breakthrough at the talks, Sky's Ivor Bennett believes the meeting - Mr Witkoff's third with Vladimir Putin this year - is significant as a sign of the Trump administration's "increasing frustration at the lack of progress".

title: Ukraine war latest: US envoy meets Putin - as Trump tells Russia to 'get moving' on peace deal
description: The UK has accused Vladimir Putin of dragging his feet on a Ukraine ceasefire at a meeting of allies - at which more than £18bn in aid was pledged to Kyiv. Meanwhile, Donald Trump's envoy has travelled to Russia for a reported meeting with Putin. Follow the latest on the Ukraine war.

title: Europe vows billions in military support
description: European countries vowed Friday to sends billions of dollars in further funding to help Ukraine keep fighting Russia’s invasion, as a U.S. envoy pursued peace efforts in a trip to meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin amid growing questions about the Kremlin’s willingness to stop the more than three-year war.

title: The US and Russia Are Negotiating in Bad Faith
description: Nina L. Khrushcheva thinks the Kremlin is laying the groundwork for a highly favorable deal on the Ukraine war.

title: Donald Trump's peace envoy Steve Witkoff flies to Russia to meet Vladimir Putin about Ukraine
description: Steve Witkoff is expected to sit down with the Russian President amid tensions between the US and Moscow's allies China and Iran.
